exact.云正盖住的镜子转不了。: A mirror under the cloud cannot be turned.
exact.云盖住的镜子转不了。: A clouded mirror will not turn.
exact.转镜子要花一拍。云盖住的镜子转不了。: Turning a mirror spends a beat. A mirror under the cloud cannot be turned.
exact.镜子不动，只让云走一步。: Leave the mirrors and let the cloud step.
exact.云会盖住神龛: the cloud will cover the shrine
exact.反斜和正斜把光折向不同的方向。状态里写着现在的光束会落到哪里。: A backslash and a slash bend the beam different ways. The status says where the beam lands now.
exact.没照到就放光，记一次错照。一次错照比两座神龛更贵。: Firing when the beam misses is a fault. One fault costs more than two shrines.
exact.把本局哪一面镜子要转成正斜还是反斜才照到神龛写进你自己的 memory。只把这些: Write which mirror had to be a slash or a backslash to hit the shrine into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
